text:
maya: Heads up — the nightly-bench-sweeper job on master failed again (CI red). Saw timeouts in the bench suite and 2 tests flaked out. @ian can you take a look when you get a sec?

maya: Log snippet:```
ERROR test_kv_eviction.py::test_eviction_race - timed out after 300.01s
  File "bench_runner.py", line 412, in run_bench
    wait_for_completion(timeout=300)
TimeoutError: bench timed out
```

sasha: Ugh, seen something similar yesterday locally — sometimes the eviction test hangs if the simulated workload clock is slow. Could be a scheduling change in the runtime.

ian: Thanks for the ping. Which CI job id and commit?

maya: Job: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/1745003210 (master@f3a9d2c). First failure at ~00:12 UTC. I kicked a quick rerun (no change to code) — will paste results.

deploy-bot: Rerun triggered by maya — build 1745003210-rerun-1 queued. :gear:

deploy-bot: Rerun complete — status: failed (same test timed out again).

oliver: Reran the bench locally on my m1 laptop, got the same hang but only after a long run. Not sure we can reproduce on CI easily.

maya: After rerun logs: one test consistently times out, another shows intermittent assertion failures in kv cache size accounting. Could be a race.

ian: Ok can someone kick a bisect on the nightly job history to narrow when this regressed? If it's in infra (sched/kernel) rather than model code, we'll need infra to triage. @sasha can you bisect?

sasha: I can start a commit-range bisect tomorrow AM. For immediate mitigation I've added a flaky label to bench/kv_cache/test_eviction.py in test-metadata (so PRs won't block CI) and opened RED-1256 with details and logs: https://jira.redwood/RED-1256 :memo:

maya: Nice — thanks. Can you also add a quick test guard in the bench harness so timeouts emit more context (KV sizes, last-op timestamps)? That'll speed root cause.

sasha: Yup, I'll add extra debug dumps on timeout. PR will go up after the bisect reproducer.

ian: If bisect points to a runtime change, I'll loop in eng-runtime and eng-infra. If it's a test harness flake, we can land a fix fast.

oliver: Quick note: rerun 2 (manual) did pass all tests once, so there's real flakiness (1/3 pass rate). Could be timing sensitive. :eyes:

maya: Good to know. For tracking: RED-1256 references the nightly job, included the failing build URL, and assigned to sasha for bisect + debug dumps. I'll schedule 1h pairing slot Tue 10:00am UTC to dig in with whoever's around.

ian: SGTM. Thanks for the triage, team. If sasha needs a bench instance or a dedicated GPU pool to reproduce, ping me and I'll allocate. :thumbsup:

sasha: Will do. Adding the reproduce steps to the ticket now.

maya: Closing loop here — marking this thread as follow-up-needed. If anyone observes other flaky bench jobs tonight, please drop them in this thread. :wave:
